title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To manage business finance, MIS reporting, project costing, budgeting, cash flow, financial closing, audits and compliance. The role supports business decisions through accurate financial analysis, effective controls and timely reporting while leading the finance team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare monthly MIS reports, project-wise P&L, budget comparisons and variance analysis.
* Coordinate annual budgets and quarterly forecasts, and analyse business performance.
* Manage project costing, pricing, resource cost rates, overheads and profitability analysis.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, bank balances and payment planning.
* Track customer billing, receivables, collections, vendor payments and reconciliations.
* Review vendor invoices, purchase orders, approvals, TDS deductions, reimbursements and advances.
* Ensure timely month-end closing, accruals, provisions and account reconciliations.
* Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Support GST/TDS compliance, financial reporting and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, records and audit documentation.
* Lead the finance team, review work, coordinate with other departments and provide training.

**Educational Qualification**

CA/CMA preferred.

MBA in Finance may be considered with strong experience in costing, financial analysis and business finance.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in Finance and Accounts, including at least 3 years in MIS, costing, pricing or business finance.
* Experience in team handling and financial reporting.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, project costing, profitability and cash flow management.
* Good understanding of accounting standards, GST, TDS, audits and financial reconciliations.
* Working experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, Tally Prime or similar ERP systems.
* Advanced MS Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI or similar tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving and team management skills.
* Experience in IT, engineering services or project-based businesses is an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely and accurate MIS reporting and financial closing.
* Effective budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
* Accurate project costing and profitability tracking.
* Improved cash flow, collections and working capital management.
* Timely customer billing and vendor payments.
* Compliance with statutory requirements and audit timelines.
* Effective team management and adherence to financial controls and SOPs.

title: Manager - Education Loan
description:
**Location Name:**
Paravur
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Assess Education Loan applications independently and consistently, balancing customer eligibility, repayment capacity, academic and employability factors, collateral support, legal and technical acceptability, and portfolio quality.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Review applicant and co-applicant identity, relationship, academics, admission, institution, course, country, test scores and requested funding.
* Assess income, banking, bureau, obligations, repayment capacity and policy eligibility.
* Evaluate cost of education, scholarships, margin or own contribution, living expenses and the proposed loan amount.
* Assess secured and unsecured structures, including property, gold or other approved collateral, through applicable reports and controls.
* Own or review Legal and Technical Assessment requirements for secured cases and ensure satisfactory reports are available before progressing the credit decision.
* Engage and coordinate with approved third-party valuers and lawyers to facilitate timely valuation, technical and legal reports; review report validity, observations, conditions and exceptions for credit consideration.
* Review verification outcomes, fraud indicators, deviations and mitigants, and raise evidence-based queries.
* Prepare or validate credit assessment notes, recommendations, sanction conditions and deviation matrices.
* Decide, recommend, refer or decline cases within the approved credit authority matrix and ensure complete decision audit trail.
* Monitor underwriting quality, approval, rejection and deviation trends, turnaround time, productivity and portfolio feedback.
* Coordinate with Sales, Risk, Operations, RCU, Collections, Legal, Technical, collateral teams and external service providers while preserving independent credit judgement.
* Provide market and portfolio feedback for policy refinement, process improvement and new product launches.
* Own the assigned credit work queue and resolve day-to-day case queries.
* Maintain accurate system records and escalate material exceptions beyond delegated authority.

**Key Decisions / Dimensions**

* Approve, recommend, refer or decline cases strictly within the approved credit authority matrix and risk policy.
* Assess the acceptability of legal, technical, valuation and collateral observations for credit decisioning within delegated authority.
* Escalate title, valuation, technical, fraud, policy, compliance and other material exceptions to the prescribed authority.
* Numeric sanction and deviation authorities are to be defined in the approved delegation matrix.

Key interactions
  
  
Internal Sales, Product, Risk, Operations, RCU/Fraud Control, Collections, Legal, Technical, Collateral, Compliance, Finance, Technology and COE.
  
  
External Students, co-applicants, approved valuers, lawyers, legal and technical agencies, verification partners and other approved service providers.
  
  
**Major Challenges**

* Balancing growth, customer experience, turnaround time and portfolio quality.
* Managing incomplete or inconsistent academic, financial, collateral, legal and technical information.
* Coordinating internal teams and third-party agencies while maintaining independent credit judgement.
* Identifying and resolving adverse legal, technical, valuation, fraud or policy observations within defined authority.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
Graduate or postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Management or a related discipline. 1-3 years of relevant experience in credit appraisal, underwriting, secured/unsecured lending or financial services; Education Loan exposure preferred.
  
  
Critical skills and knowledge
  
  

* Credit appraisal and financial analysis
* Bureau, banking and income assessment
* Academic and employability assessment
* Secured and unsecured lending
* Legal and Technical report interpretation
* Property valuation, collateral and title-risk awareness
* Third-party valuer, lawyer and vendor coordination
* Fraud-risk awareness and decision writing
* Excel, presentation and business MIS capability
* High standards of integrity, customer confidentiality and control discipline

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**
* To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six\-month period.
* EY accepts applications for this position on an on\-going basis.
* For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
* At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
   

  

 All in to shape the future with confidence.
   

  

 EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Assistant Manager Finance
description:
**Company Description** 
 Medlounges is a private hospital and wellness centre offering a holistic blend of medical and lifestyle services. The facility includes key departments such as Cosmetology, Dermatology, Ayurveda, Family Medicine, and Dentistry, supported by a 24\-hour pharmacy, physiotherapy unit, laboratory, and optical shop. An additional OPD wing with seating for 80–85 people serves the surrounding community and hosts specialist doctors for private practice. Medlounges provides home medical care services, including home visits by physicians and wellness teams, home drug delivery, and lab sample collection. The centre also features a fitness facility, accommodation options, a wellness\-focused restaurant, and an active medical tourism channel operating across multiple countries.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Assistant Manager Finance is a full\-time, on\-site role based at the Medlounges facility in Tiruvalla. This role supports the financial management of hospital and wellness centre operations, including budgeting, forecasting, and monitoring departmental expenditures. The Assistant Manager Finance oversees daily accounting activities such as accounts payable and receivable, general ledger entries, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting. The role involves ensuring compliance with relevant financial regulations, internal controls, and audit requirements, as well as preparing periodic management reports and dashboards. The Assistant Manager Finance collaborates with clinical and administrative teams to analyze financial performance, optimize cost structures, and support strategic initiatives related to medical services, wellness programs, and medical tourism.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong financial management and accounting skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Candidates should possess skills in financial reporting and compliance, including preparation of statements, adherence to regulatory standards, and support for internal and external audits.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with accounting software and spreadsheet tools, along with attention to detail and strong numerical aptitude.
* Candidates should possess organizational and time management skills to handle multiple financial processes and deadlines in a healthcare setting.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and collaboration skills to work with clinical, administrative, and management teams.
* Relevant academic qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CMA, ACCA) are an advantage.
* Experience in healthcare, hospital finance, or multi\-department service organizations is preferred, along with familiarity with medical billing and insurance processes.

title: Accountant (CA Inter or Final Mandatory)
description:
Job Role: Accountant (CA Inter or Final)
 



 Job Description: The Accountant
 
 (CA Inter or Final)
 
 plays a crucial role in managing the organization's cash flow and ensuring precise and timely accounting. This position involves various responsibilities related to bank and cash payments, taxation, reconciliation, and audit support. The candidate must ensure that all financial transactions are compliant with the organization's standards.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* **Payments \& Bank Reconciliation:**
* **Ensure payments are made based on the payment priority provided.**
* **Periodically reconcile all bank accounts to ensure accuracy.**
* **Tally Updates:**
* **Record all payment entries in Tally for both cash and bank payments.**
* **Account for all bank receipts in Tally.**
* **Payment List Management:**
* **Update the Purchase Approval Follow\-up Sheet and Payment List after each payment.**
* **Ensure accurate filing of all bank and cash vouchers.**
* **Tax Deduction:**
* **Ensure tax is deducted at the appropriate rates for all payments, including advances.**
* **Salary Management:**
* **Record salary payable entries in Tally.**
* **Vendor Advance Review:**
* **Periodically review vendor advances and ensure timely settlements.**
* **TDS Management:**
* **Prepare the TDS statement for quarterly returns and manage monthly TDS payments.**
* **Audit and Due Diligence:**
* **Assist in the timely completion of statutory audits with no adverse remarks.**
* **Support due diligence or other occasional audits.**



 Requirements:
 


* **Educational Qualification:**
* **Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) is compulsory.**
* **CA Inter or Final** 
**mandatory with 3 years of completed articleship.**
* **Skills:**
* **Proficiency in Tally and a strong grasp of accounting principles.**
* **Attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial transactions.**
* **Good organizational skills and ability to multitask.**
* **Knowledge of tax regulations, including experience in TDS management.**
* **Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teams.**
* **Experience with Zoho accounting software is an added advantage.**
